# libvterm

The MIT-licensed libvterm sources and headers come from [Vim's libvterm tree](https://github.com/vim/vim/tree/12b8ca12d0cfa252cbd344bbf4dd1f547df0abd1/src/libvterm), pinned at commit `12b8ca12d0cfa252cbd344bbf4dd1f547df0abd1`. CyUI uses this copy for its MSVC compatibility and VT emulation. The library is built only with the Terminal module. See `LICENSE`.
